questions.finding: PR #6 F4 [minor/code] src/shared/Rules/Book.luau:150-170 and src/shared/Worlds.luau:112-135: ThemeBinding.bookPage.reward is passed through Worlds, but Book.themePages builds every theme PageSummary with rewardId/rewardType/rewardNameKey = nil and rewardEarned = false, and Book.completedRewardIds ignores theme pages. A reward declared on a theme page is silently never shown or granted.
questions.question: How should a reward declared on a theme's bookPage behave in 005? The spec (spec.md line 103) defines bookPage.reward as RewardDef? and data-model.md line 103 and contracts/theme-content.md §4 say it is 'in the type for 006a; unused and not granted in 005' with rewardEarned = false. The reviewer offers two fixes: (a) wire the reward through, or (b) remove the field. Removing it changes the bookPage shape that FR-002 names, so I have not done (b). Wiring it through to completedRewardIds would grant the skin in 005, which the contract rules out.
options: A. Keep the contract: reject a non-nil bookPage.reward when the world data is validated (error at load), so data cannot declare a reward the runtime ignores. Field stays in the type. Needs FR-002 to accept a reward only once 006a lands.

B. Display only in 005: map the reward into the theme PageSummary (rewardId, rewardType, rewardNameKey, rewardEarned from skinsOwned), but keep it out of completedRewardIds so nothing is granted until 006a. Contract §4 changes (rewardEarned may be true).
C. Wire it fully (display and grant through completedRewardIds) now, which means 005 grants a reward. Contract §4 and data-model.md §5 change.
D. Remove the reward field from the type. Requires a spec change to FR-002 and data-model.md §5.
questions.recommendation: A, because it keeps FR-002 and the 'not granted in 005' contract, and makes the silent drop impossible.
